firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently went camping takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If there is a tie or this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: On a turn, reveal a card and use the tweezers to build the fire. Pass the tweezers clockwise when your turn ends.
